note.question: When are capacity constraints tight, the retailer spreads out product introductions throughout the selling season?
note.overview: Dynamic product rotation is perceived as a useful lever to increase sales. The effect over individual customers is, however, unclear: more choice in the future may induce them to postpone a purchase if the current offer is not sufficiently appealing, hoping to buy a better product in the future; moreover, visiting a store to learn about a new product may be costly, thereby diminishing the value of product updates. The paper analyzes a model of strategic customer behavior in the face of a rotating product offering, with variable assortment depth.
